nuggets.text: Blazers coach Alex Mortensen is the son of the late ESPN NFL insider Chris Mortensen.
Blazers coach Alex Mortensen won his coaching debut in 2025, a 31-24 upset of No. 22 Memphis.
Blazers coach Alex Mortensen played college football at both Arkansas and Samford.
The Blazers' program was discontinued after the 2014 season and returned to the field in 2017.
In their 2017 comeback season, the Blazers clinched bowl eligibility by beating Rice 52-21 at Legion Field.
The Blazers started as a club team in 1989 and began NCAA play in Division III in 1991.
Two hours before kickoff, the Blazers, their band and cheerleaders walk through Uptown Birmingham to Protective Stadium.
Nearly 800 first-year students led the Blazers onto the field for the 2025 season opener.
The Blazers' mascot, Blaze, is a dragon.
Blazers running back Bam McReynolds and running backs coach Hindley Brigham both spent last season at ULM.
